title: Beelitz-Heilstätten from Berlin - Quick Summary
items: **Beelitz-Heilstätten is a ruined 1902 lung sanatorium in the forest south-west of Potsdam**, later the largest Soviet military hospital outside the USSR. You visit a 7.5-hectare part of it with a **treetop walk of more than 700 m** over the roof forest of the Alpenhaus ruin.

**The hours change almost weekly this winter.** Daily 10:00 to 18:00 until 29 October, 10:00 to 16:00 in November, **closed 16 to 20 and 23 to 26 November**, then the **ZEITREISE** evening light trail from **27 November**, and **closed 11 to 29 January**.

**Until 12 December the RE7 starts at Berlin-Charlottenburg**, not Hauptbahnhof: one train an hour at weekends arriving at :58, a second one via Wannsee on weekdays. The gate is five minutes from the platform.

**An ABC ticket does not reach Beelitz.** A VBB single costs **6.30 euros** each way; the Deutschlandticket covers it. The park costs **17 euros** until October, **13.50 euros** on the winter tariff, and ZEITREISE **19 euros** online.
**You only get inside the buildings on a guided tour**, 60 to 90 minutes, **10 to 17 euros** on top of the park ticket, in German, with helmets and age limits of 7 or 12.
**My move:** pick the date first, then take the train that arrives just before opening and be on the path by 11:00, before the November light runs out.
